purposes.seed: Reproduce surface grain and fur placement without consuming gameplay randomness.
purposes.voxel_metres: Resolution used to fuse anatomical volumes into a continuous skin before smoothing.
purposes.skin_smooth_iterations: Round fused skin transitions while retaining the animal's broad proportions.
purposes.skin_decimate_ratio: Reduce the fused skin for crowds while retaining silhouette detail.
purposes.tube_sides: Roundness of tusks, antlers, wing veins and small appendages.
purposes.atlas_pixels: One embedded material atlas per family for skin, fur, ceramic, horn and narrow energy accents.
purposes.render_samples: Noise quality of the Blender review images, not runtime rendering.
purposes.render_pixels: Pixel dimensions of each Blender review image.
purposes.normal_emission_energy: Quiet light inside growth channels; existing hit, freeze and burn feedback takes priority.
purposes.motion: Cosmetic joint motion driven by existing travel, idle and attack clocks. Knee/ankle values bend lifted feet; jaw follows existing windup/release; tail/antennae soften idle; wing frequency/swing/lag distinguish a living moth without granting flight physics.

ash_hound.purpose: Long lean wolf, grown jaw/shoulder lamellae and silver-blue conducting channels; no new cold damage.

ember_whelp.purpose: Heavy porcine body, cloven hooves, grown heat shield and paired tusks; uses the existing Whelp role.

valley_elk.purpose: Long-legged cervid, open two-root crown and visible neck support; remains a passive grazer.

marsh_wisp.purpose: Marsh moth with olive/cool-grey wings and warm stored light; retains its existing Ember Kind.

cinder_wisp.purpose: Soot/copper moth with ember-orange veins and abdomen; an Ember leyline expression of the same base animal.
